breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the requested final time T=1.1 was outside the specified time domain t in [0, 1.0]. It corrected the final time to T=1.0 in all relevant parts of the output requirements, matching the ground truth. The agent even explicitly stated the correction: 'Compute the solution at final time T = 1.0 (not 1.1, as domain is [0,1.0]...)'.
